title: Timer Dock
shortDescription: A timer and stopwatch on the Dock. Type any length, record laps, and get a notification when time's up.
description:
Timer Dock puts a timer and stopwatch on the Command Palette Dock, so the time stays in view without a clock window covering your work.

- Type any length to start a countdown: 25 (minutes), 90s, 1h30m or 1:30, optionally with a label such as "10m tea". Or pick a preset from 1 to 90 minutes.
- A stopwatch with laps, shown at the top of the page with their splits.
- The Dock counts down for a timer and up for the stopwatch. When idle it's just a small stopwatch icon.
- A Windows notification when time's up, and "Time's up" on the Dock.
- Pause, resume, add time or reset from the same page. It keeps time across restarts.
- No network access, no accounts, no telemetry.

After installing, right-click the Dock, choose Edit and add the Timer & Stopwatch band, then click it.
